description: Show products from the user’s connected Shopify store or website/feed as selectable cards with reference photos. Search for a product or supply 1-6 real IDs from list_products. One candidate asks “Do you mean this product?”; several let the user choose. Use when the requested product/reference is ambiguous or a likely match needs confirming. This only displays choices: STOP and wait for the user before generating or editing. When the user already clearly confirmed a product, use that selection without asking again. On text-only channels present the returned names/photos as choices in the user’s language and wait.
name: show_product_picker
title: Choose a product
